Bundled audio decoding components

FFmpeg 8.1.3
https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-8.1.3.tar.xz
SHA256 7138d28c96d9d3e3af4ee3d8cad72741f8ffb40da90c1112235dea3ecd3178a3
Configured without GPL/nonfree options. LGPL-2.1-or-later.

WavPack 5.8.1
https://github.com/dbry/WavPack
Commit 4827b9889665b937b6ed71b9c6c0123152cd7a02
BSD-3-Clause.

DSD Nexus libsacd_lite and libsautil
https://github.com/wichers/dsd-nexus
Commit b3f443d4c42ccf52806eb57def3b3a34805714bd
LGPL-2.1-or-later. PS3 drive and network support disabled.

FFmpeg includes the accompanying ffmpeg-dst-raw-frames.patch. It expands raw
DST-frame DSD bytes into the decoder's four-byte sample stride and rejects
truncated frames before DSD-to-PCM conversion. ffmpeg-dsf-duration.patch uses
the DSF header sample count to retain the exact program duration. WavPack sources are built without source modifications.
DSD Nexus includes dsd-nexus-dst-error-codes.patch to give each read failure
a distinct negative status and preserve I/O errors. The accompanying
AudioCodecs.cpp adapter is distributed with the application's source code.
The reproducible build configuration is scripts/build-audio-codecs.sh and
Dependencies/AudioCodecs/CMakeLists.txt in the application repository.
The corresponding source archives and fixed commits are available at the
upstream locations above. License texts accompany the bundled libraries.
